name: Big City Dreaming
source:
Welcome to Big City Dreaming, an immersive visual novel that will take you on a journey through the busy life of the big city. This coming-of-age story is an exploration of the human condition, exploring themes of identity, belonging, and the search for meaning in a chaotic world.

At the heart of Big City Dreaming lies an ambitious goal: to create a cinematic experience that transports you directly into an immersive world of choice and consequences. With stunning visuals and an evocative original soundtrack and sound design, you'll be drawn deep into the city's intricate web of relationships, secrets, and hidden truths.

As you explore the city and interact with its inhabitants, you'll be faced with choices that will determine the course of the story. Will you choose to embrace the challenges of city life, or will you be overwhelmed by its harsh realities? Will you forge lasting relationships, or become lost in your own search for meaning?

At every turn, Big City Dreaming challenges you to consider the human condition in all its complexity, offering a glimpse into the lives of those who call the city home. With branching storylines, unforgettable characters, and an immersive world that feels both familiar and alien, this is a visual novel that aims to defy genre conventions and set a new standard for narrative-driven gaming.

[from [url=https://bigcitydreaming.itch.io/big-city-dreaming-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
歡迎來到《Big City Dreaming》。這部沉浸式視覺小說，將帶你走進大城市繁忙的生活。這是一段探索人類處境的成長故事，探討自我認同、歸屬，以及在混亂世界中尋找意義等主題。

本作的核心，是一個雄心勃勃的目標：打造電影般的體驗，將你直接帶入由選擇與後果構成的沉浸世界。出色的畫面、富有感染力的原創配樂與音效設計，將帶你深入這座城市錯綜複雜的人際關係、秘密與隱秘真相之中。

探索城市、與居民互動時，你會面對決定故事走向的選擇。你會勇敢迎接都市生活的挑戰，還是被殘酷的現實壓垮？你會建立長久的關係，還是迷失在自己對意義的追尋之中？

《Big City Dreaming》在每一個轉折處，都邀請你思考人類處境的複雜面貌，窺見那些以城市為家的人們的生活。憑藉分支故事、難忘角色，以及既熟悉又陌生的沉浸世界，本作希望打破類型慣例，為敘事驅動遊戲樹立新的標準。

[摘自[url=https://bigcitydreaming.itch.io/big-city-dreaming-demo]itch.io[/url]]
